question: In a molecule of water, the ratio of the mass of hydrogen to that of oxygen is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 : 8**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __Concept:__

 
• Molecular mass is the sum of the atomic masses of the elements present in a molecule.
 
• The mass of one mole of a substance in grams is called its molar
